purpose: Ten reusable layered environments, each inspired by a book painting, with a clean backdrop and two transparent scenery clusters. Adventure introduces them progressively after ten Sky Falls books; see Parallax-environments.md for the current assignment schedule.
preservation: The original ten static paintings are retained under Artwork/OriginalBackgrounds, outside the app target.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create the CLEAN DISTANT BACKDROP layer for a portrait iPhone vertical platform game, using the attached image as the edit target. Retain its sunset Mediterranean coast, turquoise sea and hazy distant mountains, lighting and painterly storybook quality. Remove ALL foreground and midground edge objects: buildings, cliffs, islands, trees, plants, props, bridges, boats, ground and close water detail. Reconstruct the obscured space as softly atmospheric distant scenery. The result must be a continuous full-bleed portrait painting, roughly 9:19, with very open uncluttered centre and lower area. Very distant soft silhouettes may remain at the edges but no sharp foreground landmarks. No foreground stars or sparkles (rendered separately), no text, characters, platforms, UI or borders. Preserve the original palette and identity; do not make a different world.

Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: individual parallax scenery cutout for an iPhone game. The attached image is a visual style and setting reference. Extract/reconstruct ONE coherent isolated cluster: a lush rocky coastal outcrop with a small white terracotta-roofed seaside cottage and palm tree. Match the reference's sunset Mediterranean coast, turquoise sea and hazy distant mountains lighting, rich painterly fantasy materials and colours. Show the whole cluster including a naturally tapered irregular rock/root underside; no rectangular scene crop. Three-quarter view, pleasing compact vertical silhouette, about 2:3 canvas. Object fills most canvas with transparent margin on ALL sides, no edge clipping. This will float along the screen edge behind gameplay. Genuine transparent alpha background, including between leaves/arches and beneath the object. No sky, ground plane, opaque atmosphere, backdrop, text, watermark, people, animals or UI. ONE cutout only, not a sprite sheet.
